archetypes.name: line-anchor-staleness
archetypes.rationale: The plan cites specific line numbers in scripts/test-design-structure.sh (397-402, 403, 404-405, 407, 409-410, 412-415) that may have drifted since the plan was authored; wrong anchors cause the implementer to edit or preserve the wrong lines.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that every specific line number the plan cites in scripts/test-design-structure.sh still matches the content claimed at HEAD — specifically that the weak `grep -Fq 'snapshot'` lines sit at 403 and 407 (not already `--snapshot-trailers` or `--dedup`), and that the preservation greps for `diff_added`, `diff_deleted`, and `mechanical_churn` are present and unchanged at lines 404-405, 409-410, and 412-415. Also check whether the (3175) block boundary the plan describes at line 397 still aligns with the current file structure. Any mismatch between plan-cited line content and current HEAD means the implementation would target the wrong lines. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shard-wiring-consistency
archetypes.rationale: The plan asserts invoke-only (no Makefile target, no shard entry) is safe for test-trailer-awk.sh because thin adapters already follow that pattern, but this claim needs repo-evidence verification against the actual Makefile and shard-coverage harness.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether existing thin-adapter scripts (test-trailer-dedup.sh, test-trailer-has-any.sh, test-trailer-validate.sh) are truly invoke-only with no standalone Makefile target or shard-coverage entry, or whether they appear registered somewhere the plan overlooks. Read the Makefile and any shard-coverage harness (e.g., make test-harness-shards-coverage or a shard mapping file) to confirm that an invoke-only test-trailer-awk.sh would not trip a coverage check. If thin adapters are registered, flag that the plan's 'no new Makefile target or shard entry needed' claim is incorrect and test-trailer-awk.sh would need explicit registration. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: md-sibling-coverage-gap
archetypes.rationale: The plan backfills .md siblings for six trailer scripts but may leave other existing scripts in the same area without siblings, leaving the script-md-siblings convention only partially satisfied and potentially tripping a lint check.
archetypes.prompt_body: Enumerate all .sh scripts in skills/design/scripts/ whose names start with test-trailer or lib-plan-optional-trailers and exist at HEAD, then cross-check against the six .md files the plan creates (test-trailer-awk.md, test-trailer-helpers.md, test-trailer-dedup.md, test-trailer-has-any.md, test-trailer-validate.md, lib-plan-optional-trailers.md). Identify any existing .sh that would still lack a paired .md after the plan's changes land. Also verify whether a script-md-siblings lint target or harness enforces one-to-one pairing so an uncovered script would fail CI. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
